# AuraPal

> Free AI career engine — 10 AI tools to build ATS-ready resumes, write cover letters, prep for interviews, roast LinkedIn profiles and resumes, benchmark salaries, find jobs and validate startup ideas. Powered by Google Gemini.

AuraPal is completely free: every tool, no credit card, no trial, no paid plan. A high daily cap (250 generations) exists only to prevent abuse. Sign in with Google to start.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of all 10 AI career tools.
- [About](/about): Mission and how AuraPal works.
- [Features](/features): Full feature list across all tools.
- [Blog](/blog): Resume, LinkedIn and salary negotiation guides.

## Tools

- [AI Resume Roast](/ai-resume-roast): 0–100 resume score with a fix for every weak section.
- [Free Resume Roast](/ai-resume-roast-free): Same roast, explained.
- [Free Salary Checker](/salary-checker-free): P25–P90 salary range and an underpaid/fair verdict.
- [Startup Idea Validator](/startup-idea-validator): Score your idea 0–100 plus a 14-day MVP plan.
